references.text: The fulfillment of the promise in verse 5 - the people shouted, and the walls fell when they heard the trumpet signal
The jubilee horn (yobel) that was to be blown in the year of jubilee, the same horn mentioned in Joshua 6:5
Use of trumpets and shouting as signals for war and gathering in Israel
Gideon's victory with the help of horns and shouts, similar warfare tactics to those at Jericho
The letter to the Hebrews refers to the fall of Jericho by faith - the walls fell after the people had marched around the city for seven days
Clapping hands and shouting to God with cries of joy, similar to the mighty shout at Jericho
Praise with the horn (shofar), the same instrument used at the fall of Jericho
The Lord's coming with a shout and God's trumpet, an eschatological parallel to the sound of the horn at Jericho
